episodes.synopsis: Jilted and heartbroken, 20-year-old Kinoshita Kazuya turns to Diamond, a Rent-A-Girlfriend app that leads him to a fateful encounter with Mizuhara Chizuru, one of the talents on offer.
episodes.title: Rent-a-Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: Immediately after deciding not to rely on pretend dating anymore, Kazuya is hit with a triple whammy of reveals: Chizuru not only goes to his college but lives next door to him, and his grandmother is coming to visit and wants to see her.
episodes.title: Ex-Girlfriend and Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: Kazuya barely has time to deal with the fallout of the situation in the pub before the gang heads off on a short trip to Izu, where they run into someone unexpected.
episodes.title: Beach and Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: Mami’s plan comes to a head as Kazuya decides to set the story straight, to mixed reactions.
episodes.title: Friend and Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: The aftermath of the ferry incident signals a clear shift in Kazuya’s feelings. Meanwhile, there’s a conspiracy brewing at the hot springs inn he and his family decide to visit.
episodes.title: Hot Springs and Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: Having to spend a night in the same room with Chizuru sends Kazuya’s heart and mind racing. Meanwhile, Kuribayashi Shun has a surprise in store…
episodes.title: Girlfriend and Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: While Kazuya desperately tries to get Ruka to promise she won’t reveal his secret, she tells him her own.
episodes.title: Provisional Girlfriend and Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: Christmas rolls around with Kazuya not having met Chizuru for ages, and he sees something he never wanted to see.
episodes.title: Christmas and Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: Ruka is hellbent on knowing the full story behind Kazuya and Chizuru’s relationship, and once she does she decides to take action.
episodes.title: Lies and Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: Kazuya learns that Kuribayashi's been down in the dumps and tries to figure out how he can help him.
episodes.title: Friend’s Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: On Chizuru's request, Kazuya goes on a practice date with Sumi, another rental girlfriend. Will he actually be able to help her and stay out of trouble while he's at it?
episodes.title: Truth and Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: Chizuru and Mami go on an awkward rental date unaware that Kazuya has seen them together. How can Chizuru handle this situation?
episodes.title: Confession and Girlfriend
